content.text:
Silhouette: Four-legged gray wolf frame. Host frame: the gray wolf sets the outline, body size and overall frame. It is a single creature that combines a crab and a gray wolf. The head is that of the gray wolf, fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Details: the body and legs are the gray wolf's, with its own dense fur on the face, belly and legs, plain coat, no stripes or spots. From the crab, as parts and materials on the gray wolf's own body, claws grown from the front feet — each front foot ends in a pincer, held folded against the foot when the animal walks — heavy, knobbed, hard-shelled claws with a fixed and a moving finger; large evenly sized claws with black tips. Hard, glossy chitin plates with fine seams in its own colors, grown from the skin as the gray wolf's own covering over the crown of the head, neck, shoulders, back, flanks, hips and tail; it replaces the gray wolf's dense fur there and conforms to the gray wolf's body. One broad, fused carapace shield over the gray wolf's shoulders and back, its edge like the donor's pie-crust frilled edge with rounded lobes, with short jointed plates on each limb section, sized to the gray wolf's body, joined by flexible cuticle at every joint. Every covered part keeps the gray wolf's own length and shape, and the tail stays the gray wolf's own tail; the dense fur stops at the covering's edge, and the face, belly and legs keep the gray wolf's own dense fur. The covering follows the body's own shape and bends at every joint. Declared fiction: arthropod parts at large size, shown with thick supporting legs. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs, visible sense organs. Habitat cue (rocky coast): dark back and light belly (strong countershading). Prosaic detail: natural lighting, feet in firm contact with the ground with a soft shadow, normal wear on hooves, claws and skin. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
Aspect ratio: 1:1.

summary.text:
**Designing hybrid wolf-crab silhouette**
I'm planning a single creature with a gray wolf's head, body, and dense fur, plus crab claws growing from the front feet, keeping the outline clean and the eyes clear.
**Refining hybrid anatomy details**
I'm detailing the wolf-crab hybrid for a natural history plate: wolf head and furred face, belly, and legs, with glossy chitin armor over the crown, back, and tail, and pincer claws on the front feet, in side three-quarter view on a plain light background.
**Regenerating hybrid leg design**
I'm adjusting the image so both front legs end in folded pincers, keeping the fur and adding jointed plates to all legs for a more consistent hybrid look.
**Finalizing hybrid creature design**
I'm locking in the wolf-legged design with chitin plates, keeping only the front pincers and fur on all legs, plus the dark back and light belly, and preparing to generate the final image.
**Refining hybrid leg design**
I'm reviewing the latest feedback and preparing another improved version that combines the stronger elements from the previous attempts.
